verdict.rationale: Puzzle's official MCP connects Claude or other AI assistants to live ledger tools (trial balance, cash activity, transactions, metrics). Its runway documentation says affordability-style questions are projected 'from your live books' and can be asked through the Puzzle MCP. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hypothetical 'what if we spend X' scenario answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Puzzle projects your cash from your live books: how long your cash lasts at your current burn, the month you'd run out, when to start raising
ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP

Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
Once connected, open a new conversation and start exploring your financials.
